text:
Welcome to Pho Gia Truyen Bát Đàn, a renowned family-run beef pho shop located at 49 Bat Dan. This establishment has earned recognition as a Bib Gourmand from the Michelin Guide, a testament to its quality and taste. 

You can enjoy a delicious bowl of pho here for approximately 55,000 to 70,000 VND. The shop opens its doors in the morning from 5:30 or 6:00 AM until 10:00 or 11:00 AM. There are also reports of an evening session from 5:00 or 6:00 PM to 8:30 or 9:30 PM, but it's always a good idea to double-check the hours before your visit, as they may vary.

Be prepared for some hustle and bustle, as the shop is often busy with queues. It's a self-service setup, so you'll need to grab your own drinks and condiments. This is the perfect spot to experience the authentic flavors of Vietnamese cuisine. Enjoy your meal!
